'''Onjo Fegel''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officer during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign. A muscular young [[Gender/Legends|man]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuttin IV]], he was a talented [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] player and a member of one of the best amateur [[b'ssa nuuvu]] bands.

==History==
Fegel was a graduate of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] with a concentration in Intelligence, which allowed him to meet [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Shran Etison]], who shared his love for b'ssa nuuvu music.

On a mission to [[Six Local Systems]], Fegel joined the band [[Far Cry]], in an effort to try and ferret out the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team aiding the accused spy [[Keth Beamis]] on [[Beltrix III]]. Upon arriving on Beltrix III, Fegel quit the band and set out on an attempt to catch the [[Holstrum Talent Agency]] in the act of aiding the Alliance, which in turn would garner him a posting in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. However, Fegel was unaware that [[Ryley Ancum]] had already sent a secret message to Beltrix III, warning the local cell of an Imperial presence; Fegel failed to uncover anything and was sent back to his homeworld without a promotion.
